newsitem.title: ROMANIA: MINOR TREMOR SHAKES EASTERN ROMANIA.
newsitem.headline: MINOR TREMOR SHAKES EASTERN ROMANIA.

text.p: A minor earthquake shook eastern Romania on Sunday, but no incident was reported, state television said.

The state television quoted the National Earth Physics Institute as saying the tremor -- with a preliminary magnitude of 4.3 degrees on the Richter open-ended scale -- occured at 4.26 p.m. local (1326 GMT) in the eastern mountain region of Vrancea, 300 km (190 miles) northeast of the capital.
It said the tremor was not felt in Bucharest.
